text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is this it? Is it just... over for me? Coming
to Tracen was a dream come
true, but as I
gaze out across campus, the view has lost
its rosy tint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I first set foot on these grounds convinced
of my future success as a
trainer. But now,
that confidence is all but gone.

Goodness me, I've never heard a sigh so
heavy.

Did we hit a little bump in the road? When
you're feeling down, it's
no good to stew
on it all alone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Me? Well, if you want to know, Wonder
Acute's the name. I don't
believe we've
met before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hope I didn't startle you just now. You
looked like you were about
ready to burst
into tears, so I thought I'd ask what's the
matter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I let myself be seen like
this. It's a trainer's job to listen
to students'
career woes, not the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you poor thing, let's get that lost
puppy look off your face.
Maybe you just
need a bite to eat. How about some
crunchy
munchies?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By "crunchy munchies" I'm guessing she
means these pickled radishes.
Usually I'd
pass, but I really need this right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crunch... crunch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The salty flavor reminds me of the tears I'd
been holding back.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, if your taste buds are still working,
you'll be all right yet. Now,
why don't you
tell me what happened? Take as much
time as you
need.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her gentle prodding, the words I'd
intended to keep bottled up
spill out of
my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're changing my routine again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was in a trial period with this student. She
needed to improve her
explosiveness, so I
suggested we do more uphill training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her muscles had great potential for speed,
and my aim was to unlock
it by pushing her
to her limits.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just... I don't like how we're doing
something different every time.
I've asked
around, and everyone else's routines
sound way more
balanced.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Can I really trust this trainer? Like, I'm
sure winning whatever award at trainer

school is a big deal, but still, this is a fresh
graduate we're talking about...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sorry, but could we forget about
the whole training contract
thing?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, maybe it just wasn't meant to be?
But surely just one
rejection is nothing to
fuss over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the few months I've been here, no less
than eleven students have
turned down a
contract with me, if you count those who
didn't even
want to do a trial period.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now that's a load of baloney. You take
your job serious enough to
get all tore up
over it—that's got to count for something
if you ask
me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know, how about we try a little
something? Trainer, do you have
time to
spare right now?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm going to be competing in the
upcoming Tracen Meet, you
see. And I
figured I might as well do my best to
prepare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Meet is a race event held on
campus. Only students can
compete, but
spectators flock in from all over.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Having a trainer to guide me would be a
big help, don't you think?
Though you
might not get much satisfaction watching a
runner like
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should be happy for another chance to
prove myself as a trainer. But
if I lose the
trust of yet another student...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you look awfully anxious about
this. Don't you worry, I'm
tougher than I
look, so I know I can handle anything you
throw at me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
For starters, why don't I go and run a quick
lap? If you notice anything
I can improve
on, you can tell me after.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop Wonder Acute just as she's about to
run off. Something caught
my eye while
she was doing stretches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's fairly common for one leg to be more
flexible than the other. The
sooner she
realizes this and adjusts her stretching
routine accordingly,
the better.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See? I knew it in my bones you'd make a
trustworthy trainer! We only
just met, and
you're already looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course not, dear. You're only saying it
for my sake. Not to mention,
I do notice
that my right leg is more liable to give me
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying I should be giving it an
extra stretch before I run.
Well, you learn
something new every day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wake up the next morning at my
complete mess of a desk, the result
of a
long night of brainstorming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I would draw up one training plan, only to
immediately scrap it for
another, the
optimal plan always just out of reach. It
seems I forgot to
eat and sleep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My next session with Wonder Acute is in a
few hours. I hope she won't
find the new
routine too intense...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And a one, nice and low, and a two, there
we go.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. You're quite the early bird
today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wouldn't want to let what you
taught me go to waste, you
know. Got to
make sure I'm all ready for another intense
workout.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been excited to see how you train
me—it's all I could think about.
Now then,
I say we get right to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her eyes glimmer with anticipation
warms my heart. As a
trainer, there really is
no better feeling than earning the trust of
your
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make up my mind to do as much as I
possibly can for Wonder Acute
in the short
time we have before the Tracen Meet.
